senses.gloss: m. (olearius, ὀλεάριος S.) keeper of clothes at the baths.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maaser Sheni 1:1:18">Y. Maas. Sh. I, 52ᵈ</cite> top <he>מעות הנתונות לא׳</he> tokens (in place of small change) given to the olearius; cmp.
<cite ref="Tosefta Ma'aser Sheni 1:4">Tosef. Maas. Sh. I, 4</cite>.—
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 22:1">Pesik. R. s. 22</cite>; a. e.—Pl. <he>אוֹלְיָארִין</he>, <he>אוֹלְיָירִין</he>.

<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 2:12">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. II, 12</cite> <he>מגררות של אוּלְיָרִין</he> ed. Zuck. (oth. ed. <he>אולו׳</he> corr. acc.) the brushes (strigils) of the bathing attendants.
